description.en: Capability Manager for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: manage MCP servers (~/.dsh/mcp.json, live mount/unmount) and Skills (~/.dsh/skills, toggle/delete/import/folder-sync) from a Settings-page UI. Dual-face dsh plugin (host + browser half), no DSH source changes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Desktop 能力管理器：在设置页内统一管理 MCP server（~/.dsh/mcp.json，实时挂载/卸载）与 Skill（~/.dsh/skills，开关/删除/导入/文件夹同步）。官方双面插件（host + 浏览器端），不改 DSH 源码。
